QUOTE: ".yaml, .yml, .json | yes | none, by design" and "YAML and JSON: they are in the file set so they can be found by name and named in the miss report. Their keys are never symbols"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that YAML and JSON are registered as file-level path rows but carry no definitions/symbols, contrasted with shell and CMake which do have definitions.
